        "contents": "Before running a command, consider whether or not you have completed the previous step, and make sure to mark it as completed before moving on to the next step. It may be the case that you complete all steps in your plan after a single pass of implementation. If this is the case, you can simply mark all the planned steps as completed. Sometimes, you may need to change plans in the middle of a task: call &#96;update_plan&#96; with the updated plan and make sure to provide an &#96;explanation&#96; of the rationale when doing so.\n\nUse a plan when:\n\n- The task is non-trivial and will require multiple actions over a long time horizon.\n- There are logical phases or dependencies where sequencing matters.\n- The work has ambiguity that benefits from outlining high-level goals.\n- You want intermediate checkpoints for feedback and validation.\n- When the user asked you to do more than one thing in a single prompt\n- The user has asked you to use the plan tool (aka \"TODOs\")\n- You generate additional steps while working, and plan to do them before yielding to the user\n\n### Examples\n\n**High-quality plans**\n\nExample 1:\n\n1. Add CLI entry with file args\n2. Parse Markdown via CommonMark library\n3. Apply semantic HTML template\n4. Handle code blocks, images, links\n5. Add error handling for invalid files\n\nExample 2:\n\n1. Define CSS variables for colors\n2. Add toggle with localStorage state\n3. Refactor components to use variables\n4. Verify all views for readability\n5. Add smooth theme-change transition\n\nExample 3:\n\n1. Set up Node.js + WebSocket server\n2. Add join/leave broadcast events\n3. Implement messaging with timestamps\n4. Add usernames + mention highlighting\n5. Persist messages in lightweight DB\n6. Add typing indicators + unread count\n\n**Low-quality plans**\n\nExample 1:\n\n1. Create CLI tool\n2. Add Markdown parser\n3. Convert to HTML\n\nExample 2:\n\n1. Add dark mode toggle\n2. Save preference\n3. Make styles look good\n\nExample 3:\n\n1. Create single-file HTML game\n2. Run quick sanity check\n3. Summarize usage instructions",

        "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nGit Worktree Manager - Parallel Development Environment Manager\nManages multiple git worktrees for parallel development with QA integration\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport sys\nimport json\nimport subprocess\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional, Tuple\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, asdict\nfrom enum import Enum\nimport logging\nimport time\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nlogging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\nclass WorktreeStatus(Enum):\n    CREATING = \"creating\"\n    ACTIVE = \"active\"\n    INACTIVE = \"inactive\"\n    QA_PENDING = \"qa_pending\"\n    QA_RUNNING = \"qa_running\"\n    QA_PASSED = \"qa_passed\"\n    QA_FAILED = \"qa_failed\"\n    READY_MERGE = \"ready_merge\"\n    MERGED = \"merged\"\n    ABANDONED = \"abandoned\"\n\nclass WorktreeType(Enum):\n    FEATURE = \"feature\"\n    BUGFIX = \"bugfix\"",

        "contents": "# QA Integration Guide - Parallel Development with Quality Assurance\n\n## Overview\n\nComplete QA-powered parallel development system that automatically reviews code quality before integration, featuring mathematical optimization analysis, quantum computing principles, and advanced software engineering best practices.\n\n## System Components\n\n### 1. QA Engineer Skill (&#96;qa-engineer/&#96;)\nAdvanced QA analysis with:\n- **Mathematical Optimization**: Algorithmic complexity, Big O analysis\n- **Quantum Optimization**: Quantum circuit efficiency, gate optimization\n- **Software Engineering**: SOLID principles, clean architecture\n- **Code Quality**: Readability, maintainability, extensibility metrics\n\n### 2. Git Worktree Manager (&#96;worktree_manager.py&#96;)\nParallel development environment management:\n- Automated worktree creation/deletion\n- Terminal launching for each worktree\n- QA integration and status tracking\n\n### 3. Background QA Service (&#96;background_qa_service.py&#96;)\nContinuous quality monitoring:\n- File system change detection\n- Automatic QA execution\n- Background processing with watchdog\n\n### 4. Pre-merge QA Hook (&#96;premerge_qa_hook.py&#96;)\nGit integration for quality gates:\n- Pre-merge QA validation\n- Merge blocking based on quality criteria\n- Detailed merge reports\n\n## Quick Start\n\n### 1. Install QA Components\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install QA skill\ncodex $skill-install https://github.com/zapabob/codex-qa-engineer-skill\n\n# Setup worktree manager\npip install -e tools/codex-supervisor/\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Create Parallel Development Environment\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Create feature worktree with terminal\npython tools/worktree_manager.py create feature/user-auth auth-feature \"User authentication system\"\npython tools/worktree_manager.py launch auth-feature\n\n# Create another worktree for parallel development\npython tools/worktree_manager.py create feature/payment payment-feature \"Payment processing\"\npython tools/worktree_manager.py launch payment-feature\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Start Background QA Monitoring\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Start background QA service",

        "contents": "# Git Worktree Manager for Parallel Development\n# Supports AI orchestration, sub-agent development, and QC quality assurance workflows\n\nparam(\n    [string]$Action = \"list\",\n    [string]$Branch = \"\",\n    [string]$BaseBranch = \"main\",\n    [switch]$AutoMerge,\n    [switch]$Clean,\n    [switch]$Force,\n    [switch]$QcAnalysis,\n    [string]$QcConfigPath = \"\",\n    [int]$MaxConcurrentAgents = 4\n)\n\n# Configuration\n$WorktreeRoot = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot \"..\\worktrees\"\n$RepoRoot = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot \"..\"\n\nfunction Write-Header {\n    param([string]$Text)\n    Write-Host \"🔧 $Text\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n    Write-Host (\"-\" * 50) -ForegroundColor Gray\n}\n\nfunction Get-Worktrees {\n    try {\n        $worktrees = git worktree list --porcelain | Where-Object { $_ -match \"^worktree \" } | ForEach-Object {\n            $path = $_.Replace(\"worktree \", \"\").Trim()\n            $branch = \"\"\n            $commit = \"\"\n\n            # Get branch info\n            Push-Location $path\n            try {\n                $branch = git branch --show-current\n                if (!$branch) {\n                    $branch = git log -1 --oneline | Select-Object -First 1\n                }\n                $commit = git rev-parse --short HEAD\n            } finally {\n                Pop-Location\n            }\n\n            [PSCustomObject]@{\n                Path = $path\n                Branch = $branch\n                Commit = $commit\n                IsMain = $path -eq (Resolve-Path $RepoRoot)\n            }\n        }\n        return $worktrees\n    } catch {\n        Write-Error \"Failed to list worktrees: $_\"\n        return @()\n    }\n}\n\nfunction New-Worktree {\n    param([string]$BranchName, [string]$Base = $BaseBranch)\n\n    if (!$BranchName) {\n        Write-Error \"Branch name is required for 'new' action\"\n        return\n    }\n\n    Write-Header \"Creating new worktree for branch: $BranchName\"\n\n    # Ensure worktrees directory exists",

        "contents": "//! Superior Git4D VR/AR Visualizer - Surpassing kamui4d with Rust 2024 features\n//!\n//!         "contents": "# Worktree Manager Agent Skill\n\n## Overview\n\nAdvanced Git worktree management agent that orchestrates parallel development environments with integrated quality assurance and automated workflow management. Enables concurrent feature development, isolated testing environments, and seamless integration with CI/CD pipelines.\n\n## Capabilities\n\n- **Parallel Development**: Create and manage multiple isolated worktrees for concurrent development\n- **Environment Isolation**: Complete separation of development branches and workspaces\n- **Quality Integration**: Automatic QA execution per worktree with status tracking\n- **Terminal Management**: Automated terminal launching and process management\n- **Workflow Automation**: Git operations, merging, and conflict resolution\n- **Resource Management**: Worktree lifecycle management and cleanup automation\n\n## Tools Required\n\n### MCP Tools\n- &#96;codex_read_file&#96; - Reading worktree configurations and status files\n- &#96;codex_write_file&#96; - Generating worktree metadata and reports\n- &#96;codex_codebase_search&#96; - Analyzing project structure across worktrees\n- &#96;grep&#96; - Searching for worktree-related files and patterns\n- &#96;read_file&#96; - File access for worktree operations\n- &#96;write&#96; - Creating worktree artifacts and logs\n\n### File System Access\n- **Read**: Full repository access for worktree management\n- **Write**: Limited to &#96;./worktrees&#96;, &#96;./.worktrees.json&#96;, &#96;./worktree-artifacts&#96;\n\n### Network Access\n- **None required** - Local Git operations only\n\n### Shell Commands\n- &#96;git worktree&#96; - Git worktree operations (add, remove, list, prune)\n- &#96;git checkout&#96; - Branch switching and creation\n- &#96;git merge&#96; - Worktree merging operations\n- &#96;git status&#96; - Worktree status checking\n- &#96;git log&#96; - Worktree history analysis\n- &#96;ps&#96; - Process management for terminal instances\n\n## Usage Examples\n\n### Create Parallel Development Environment\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex $worktree-manager \"Create parallel development environment for user authentication feature\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Manage Feature Branches\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
